key_highlights: Iron ore crash confirmed, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX and materials sector broadly
Oil price spike lifts energy names but pressures airlines (QAN.AX, SYD.AX) and consumer costs
ASX treads water ahead of Fed meeting; global rate uncertainty dominates sentiment
ANZ.AX restructuring after 3,500 job cuts signals ongoing financials sector consolidation
Housing market shows no spring bounce; auction weakness raises REIT and construction concerns
Australia nears energy inflection point, supporting renewables and grid infrastructure plays
Nvidia 2GW Australia AI data centre push signals long-term tech infrastructure demand
China policy pivot toward Trump regime adds geopolitical risk to commodity demand outlook
Fuel price blowout pressures Albanese government for second excise cut, boosting consumer staples

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; China demand pivot and Trump trade policy create structural headwinds. Small-cap exploration (tin-tungsten, gold, graphite) shows resilience.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Forrestania (FOR.AX), Critica (CRA.AX), Sarytogan (SGT.AX) offer selective exploration upside. PLC Resources (PLC.AX) WA gold target adds to gold sector interest.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX post-restructuring (3,500 cuts) signals sector-wide cost discipline. Housing weakness pressures NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX loan growth. Superannuation system scrutiny adds regulatory risk.
sectors.implications: Banks face dual pressure from weak property cycle and productivity concerns. Dividend sustainability under question if credit losses rise.

sectors.trend: Oil spike benefits Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), Origin (ORG.AX). Australia's energy inflection point supports renewables (AEMO, AGL.AX, CSG.AX). TMK Energy Mongolian gas flows add LNG supply context.
sectors.implications: Energy names outperform in oil-driven rally but fuel cost pass-through pressures downstream consumers and airlines.

sectors.trend: Fuel blowout and second excise cut pressure squeeze margins. WES.AX, WOW.AX benefit from defensive rotation. QAN.AX, SYD.AX hit by jet fuel costs. Gen Z alcohol decline pressures WBC.AX beverage arm.
sectors.implications: Defensive consumer staples preferred; discretionary and transport names under pressure.

sectors.trend: Nvidia 2GW Australia AI push signals major data centre buildout. AI monitoring (Datadog, Dynatrace) and agentic AI (Salesforce) themes active globally. AMD Halo Station limited near-term revenue.
sectors.implications: Australian power and infrastructure names (SGH.AX, INC.AX) benefit from AI data centre demand. Local tech remains thin but indirect beneficiaries emerge.

sectors.trend: No spring bounce in auction market; house price decline continues. Public housing failures in WA signal structural supply gaps. REITs face occupancy and yield pressure.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) under pressure. Construction and building materials names cautious.

key_themes: Iron ore structural decline vs. China policy pivot
Oil-driven energy outperformance vs. consumer cost pressure
Housing market correction and REIT stress
Immigration policy uncertainty affecting labour supply and productivity

Financial sector restructuring and credit risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price crash and China demand deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (NVS.AX, SGH.AX) and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price decline and credit cycle risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight property REITs; monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX loan loss provisions; favour defensive financials

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price volatility and fuel cost pass-through
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge consumer exposure; favour WDS.AX, STO.AX; avoid QAN.AX, SYD.AX short-term

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate decision and global liquidity shift
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AUD/USD; position for potential AUD weakness; favour export-oriented miners over domestic cyclicals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical risk: China-US tensions and Trump policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-exposed commodity names; favour domestic energy and infrastructure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Immigration policy uncertainty and productivity gap
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor labour-intensive sectors; favour capital-intensive and automation plays

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian energy producers on oil spike and energy transition
opportunities.rationale: Oil price rise plus domestic energy inflection supports WDS.AX, STO.AX, ORG.AX earnings and dividends

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure in gold and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crash shifts capital to gold (PLC.AX, FOR.AX) and battery-grade graphite (SGT.AX) as diversification

opportunities.recommendation: Position for AI infrastructure buildout beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Nvidia 2GW Australia push drives power, cooling, and construction demand; SGH.AX and INC.AX benefit
Fuel cost pressure and housing weakness drive rotation into WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSL.AX

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge iron ore and China-exposed materials
defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash and China policy pivot create structural downside for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
No auction bounce, falling house prices, and public housing failures signal prolonged property weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor ANZ.AX and bank credit exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Post-restructuring execution risk and housing-driven credit losses could pressure financials

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and global rate risk ahead of Fed
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed meeting focus and 'stock shock' narrative suggest volatility spike; AUD may weaken

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower. Iron ore crash and housing weakness offset by oil-driven energy strength. Fed meeting adds volatility. 'Stock shock' narrative suggests elevated risk-off positioning. Expect 2-4% index volatility over coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore dependence accelerates. Energy transition and AI infrastructure create new growth vectors. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months. Productivity gap and immigration policy uncertainty cap earnings growth. Diversification into gold, critical minerals, and tech infrastructure is the medium-term theme.
